capabilities: Open .txt files in a dedicated read-only view
Show stable line numbers with soft wrap on or off
Search inside a file and move between matching lines
Filter to matching lines while keeping original line numbers
Report counts, line-ending type, mixed endings and possible binary content
extras: Makes no network requests and does not use the clipboard. Renders only the first 10,000 lines, or the first 1,000 matching lines in filter mode, and reports the rest. Beta installs are available through BRAT.
motivation: The author wanted quick inspection of plain text exports, AI output, notes from other systems and generated files, and avoided writing to disk because editing plain text creates risk around encodings, line endings and accidental changes.
problem: Opening a raw .txt file in Obsidian gives no line numbers, no way to filter or jump between matching lines, and risks accidental edits to generated or exported text.
summary: Read-only viewer that opens .txt files with line numbers, in-file search navigation, line filtering and large-file render caps.
